rate_limits.correction: Rate limits are requests-per-second limits, distinct from credits. Free, Developer, Business, and Professional plans respectively allow 10, 50, 200, and 500 RPC requests/s and 2, 10, 50, and 100 DAS/Enhanced API requests/s; Enterprise limits are custom, and some endpoints have special limits.

notes: The docs URL redirects to www.helius.dev/docs. api.helius.xyz is the Wallet REST base; RPC and DAS use helius-rpc.com endpoints. The balance path is obsolete. Rate limits are RPS-based, separate from credits. The free plan currently includes 1M monthly credits. Wallet header authentication uses X-Api-Key, not Authorization. Enhanced Transactions remains available but is legacy/deprecated. No general CORS policy was found.
